comment: The (n+1)-strand braid group B_{n+1} has n generators s_1,...,s_n with relations s_i s_k s_i = s_k s_i s_k for k=i+1, s_i s_k = s_k s_i for k>i+1. The elements are the isotopy classes of (n+1) free strands that are planarily "mixed" (s_i corresponds to the operation of crossing the i-th strand under the (i+1)-th strand).
